notes: The Messages API accepts THREE image source types: base64, url, and file — the file source references a Files-API upload by its file_id ("Upload the image once, then reference the returned file_id in subsequent messages instead of resenting base64 data"). The file_id is opaque and account-scoped: a proxy cannot resolve it to bytes, so it rides the IR as an identity to preserve on same-protocol round trips; cross-protocol encodes drop the image as a named degradation (a target that is not the origin account cannot fetch the file). TRANSCRIBED from the documented example (the field spellings type/file_id are the docs' own).
